Cure Disease and Abolish Disease no longer drop Shadowform (held back until now as single-source). Vampiric Embrace can no longer crit.

Blizzard: classes deal more damage and higher-level creatures have more health; no big tuning before raids open on 9 Dec, then a large pass once players are past 30. Training 1 to 60 now costs 206 to 207 gold for every class; new spells no longer auto-fill your bars; bags must be equipped by hand.

Warlock: Wrack's level-60 base damage per second 36 to 86 with a doubled coefficient; Shadow and Flame up to 20% (was 10%); demons 2 health per Stamina (was 7.5); Spellstones now Shadow only; Improved Drains no longer boosts Wrack.
